_comment: Local development overrides. Detailed EF Core SQL logging stays OFF by default; raise Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Database.Command to Information only while diagnosing a query.

Auth._comment: Local only. The reset token is echoed to anonymous callers so the Forgot Password page works without an email provider. Off by default because a response that differs for a real account lets an attacker enumerate valid user names.

Sms._comment: Local development writes texts to logs/sms-drop; nothing is transmitted.

Email._comment: Local development uses the file sink: every message is written to the folder below as a .eml plus a readable .txt, and nothing is transmitted. Stated here for discoverability - the code defaults to File in Development anyway, so building a mail feature can never reach a real inbox. Do not set Provider to Smtp on a development machine unless you have pointed it at a local capture server.
